Airwallex exists to simplify global finance, managing high-frequency transactions across markets like the US, EU, Australia, and Singapore. To support this scale, the company utilizes a globally distributed microservices architecture where each domain is assigned a dedicated database to ensure fault isolation and security. While this model supports rapid growth, it resulted in a massive fleet of more than 5,000 databases. Managing such a vast fleet presented significant challenges in identifying performance bottlenecks like slow queries across thousands of instances. Airwallex needed an operating model that could keep pace with rapid global expansion. Google Cloud’s global footprint means we can spin up isolated, enterprise-grade databases in new regions in minutes.

solution_components.name: Cloud SQL Enterprise Plus
solution_components.role: Stores transactional state and application data for the operational workflow at low latency.

solution_components.name: Database Center
solution_components.role: Provides fleet-wide visibility into database health, performance, and maintenance operations.
